data.camera: cowboy shot, standing on the royal capital castle roof and looking toward the horizon
data.description: 【三笠 · 自由之翼下】王都城堡的屋顶上，三笠迎着夕阳而立，绿色披风与红围巾同时被风托起，她微微抬头望向墙外的方向——「总有一天，我们要走出这些墙。」
data.promptProse: Mikasa stands on the royal capital castle roof, slightly lifting her head toward the world beyond the Walls. Her green Survey Corps cape and red scarf rise together over the brown uniform. The cowboy view includes roof tiles beneath her and the distant Wall across the horizon. Golden slanting sunset catches the cape edge and ODM blades, with lengthened rooftop shadows carrying the perspective back behind her.
data.title: 三笠 · 自由之翼下
